purpose: Isolate sixth-domain segmentation update dual vs joint on same frozen pilot T4 origin; joint is a mechanistic control and not a proposed replacement SMG or complete six-domain training.
initial_checkpoint: fixed pilot seed11 fifth task segmentation, generator and optimizer; branch not exact resume
replay: both use final clamp, all site6 train masks and five old site prompts, 200 sampling; generated independently per arm, not bitwise paired
training: 20 epochs, batch8, CE+soft foreground dice; dual-meta vs joint current+replay loss
gate: all 4 arms complete and finite; joint versus dual old sites1/2 across-seed mean >=0.05 improvement and no across-seed site1,2,6 mean is worse by >0.02; qualifies only for further mechanism study, not automatic method replacement
gpu_rule: only 1 and 5, one arm per GPU, >=16GiB free before each launch
